The '''Decimator Laboratory''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] laboratory on [[Eredenn Prime|Eredenn]] used to house the control codes for the [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]] weapon during its testing. It was seized by [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the [[Battle of Eredenn]]. Tann stole a [[Protocol droid/Legends|data droid]] from the laboratory, which she took to [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] to finish unlocking the Decimators for the use of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
